create_memory_pool_configurator: create a memory pool configurator factory that selects the right configurator for a model architecture
calculate_pool_sizes: calculate KV cache pool sizes from available GPU memory bytes and page size
calculate_pool_sizes_from_max_tokens: recalculate KV cache pool sizes from a constrained max_tokens value and page size
build_memory_pool_config: build a MemoryPoolConfig dataclass with resolved pool sizes and optional running request limits
compute_cell_size: compute per-token KV cache cost in bytes for standard models using MHA, MLA, NSA, or FP4 backends
